cues: Never combine more with er: not more better.
Than any country must be than any other country.
Compare like with like: the climate of Pokhara is better than that of Kathmandu.
Among three, use the superlative: the tallest of the three.
Unique, perfect, round and empty are absolute, so no degrees: a unique design.
And say it once: sufficient, not sufficient enough.
